book.name: Yohana
book.title: Malobhi Manyahi ngati moghalembakike na Yohana

content: “Numpwaghi mambu ghanihagha ghokapi, nahuli ngamwauleka uhobhalelu winu.
Bhandu anabhuntopula mwenga mu nyumba ya kuhimangani Bhayahude, na chikahi chihika kila mundu joanaankomaje akahambukya kubha antende Chapanga ibada.
Anabhuntendila mambu ghanihagha, kwa ndandi ngachebhummanyi Atati, wala nepani.

Nambu numpwaghili mambu ghanihagha, nahuli chikahi chela pachihikaje, mpata kukomboka kubha nyomwi kumpwaghila. Lihengu laka Roho Mhuhu “Ngachenumpwaghili mambu ghanihagha kutumbu pakutumbula, maghambu nakabhi papamu na mwehapa.”
Nambu sajenu nyenda kwaka jombi joandumike, na wala ngajoanalukila, “Bho, ujenda kwako?”
Nambu kwa ndandi numpwaghi mambu ghanihagha, mitima jinu jitwelili huzuni.
Nambu nepani numpwaghi chakaka, impalika mwehapa nepani mokaje, maghambu nangakubhoka nepani, Mjangatila hoju ngaahiki kwinu. Nambu nepani anambiti, ananuntuma kwinu.
Jombi paanahikaje, jonihoju anaabhalangiha bhandu bha pundema kubha maholalelu ghabhu nga manyahi panani ja mahoku, panani ja kujetakalewa palongi jaka Chapanga, na panani ja utemulu waka Chapanga.
Kwa malobhi gha mahoku, maghambu ngachebhanhobhali nepani.
Kwa malobhi gha kujetakalewa palongi jaka Chapanga, maghambu nyenda kwa Atati, na mwehapa ngamwimoni kabhete.
Kwa malobhi gha utemulu waka Chapanga, maghambu Shetani, nkolongwa wa ndema ghoni ajomwi kutemuliwa.
“Mi naghu mambu ghamaheli gha kumpwaghila, nambu kwa sajenu ngamuwezi kughakamula.

Nambu jombi paanahikaje, Roho Mhuhu wa chakaka, anaandonguha mwehapa mu chakaka jokapi. Maghambu ngayipwaghi kwa ndandi jaki mweni, nambu ghokapi ghayijowanaje kuhuma kwaka Chapanga anaaghapwaghaje, na mambu ghaghahika anaampwaghila malobhi ghaki.
Jombi anaanumbalyaje nepani, kwa ndandi anaatola ghaghabhi ghangu, na kumpwaghi mwehapa.
Ghokapi ghaabhi naghu Atati nde ghangu, nde ndandi nakapwaghiki Roho Mhuhu anaatola ghaghabhi ghangu, na kumpwaghi mwehapa.”
Huzuni na chiheku
“Chihighali chikahi kichokopi, mwehapa ngamwimone, na kabhete, chihighali chikahi kichokopi, mwehapa anammonaje, maghambu nyenda kwa Atati.”

Panihapa bhakumu bha bhabhulwa bhaki bhakalaluhini, “Bho, lilobhi bhole leapwagha heli, paatupwaghi, ‘Chihighali chikahi kichokopi, mwehapa ngamwimone, na kabhete, chihighali chikahi kichokopi, mwehapa anammonaje?’ Na paapwagha, ‘Maghambu nyenda kwa Atati?’ ”
Bhela bhakapwaghike, “Bho, lilobhi bhole leniheli leapwagha, ‘Chihighali chikahi kichokopi?’ Ngachetumanyi alongale panani ja kike!”

Yesu akamanyi kubha bhapala kundalukila, bhela akabhapwaghile, “Bho, mlaluhana panani ja ghala ghanapwaghiki, ‘Chihighali chikahi kichokopi, mwehapa ngamwimone, na kabhete, chihighali chikahi kichokopi, mwehapa anammonaje?’
Chakaka numpwaghila, mwehapa anamlelaje na kuombuleza, nambu bhandu bha pundema anabhahekalyaje. Na mwehapa anajumbina mitima jinu, nambu mabhinilu ghinu anaghang'anambuka na kubha chiheku.
Mbomba paalibhopola, lumbina lipyanda kwa ndandi chikahi chaki chihikike. Nambu anaajomwi kulibhopo mwana, ngacheakomboka kabhete mabhinilu ghala, kwa ndandi ja chiheku cha kubhelakeka mwana pundema.
Sajenu mwehapa mbi na mabhinilu, nambu nepani ananumbona kabhete, na mitima jinu anajihekalyaje, na chiheku chinu njeta mundu wa kumbokeha.
“Mu lichobha lela ngamwilalukile lilobhi lokapi. Numpwaghi Chakaka, ngati anamundobhiki Atati chindu chokapi kwa lihina langu, jombi anaampekyaje.
Mbaka sajenu ngachendobhiki chindu chokapi kwa lihina langu. Ndobhaje, na mwehapa anampataje, nahuli chiheku chinu chikamilikaje.
Yesu auweziki ndema
“Numpwaghi mambu ghanihagha kwa ulenganesu. Nambu chikahi chihika ambapu nganipwaghi na mwehapa kabhete kwa ulenganesu, nambu ananumpwaghilaje hotuhotu malobhi gha Atati.
Mu lichobha lela mwilobhaje kwa lihina langu, na wala ngachenumpwaghila kubha nepani ananundobhila kwa Atati,
kwa ndandi Atati mwene ampala mwehapa. Maghambu mwehapa mumbaliki nepani, na kuhobhalela kubha nepani nakahumiki kwaka Chapanga.”
Nepani nakahumiki kwa Atati, nanatu nhikiki pani pundema, na kabhete nuleka ndema, na kujenda kwa Atati.
Bhela bhabhulwa bhaki bhakapwaghike, “Lingalyaje, sajenu upwagha hotuhotu, wala ngacheupwagha kwa malenganesu ghokapi ghala.
Sajenu tumanyi kubha wehapa umanyi mambu ghokapi, na wala ngachekubhi na ndandi jaka mundu kukulalukila, bhela tuhobhalela kubha ukahumiki kwaka Chapanga.”
Yesu akabhayangike, “Bho, sajenu le muhobhalela?
Lingalyaje, chikahi chihika, ena, chijomwi kuhika, pamwipechanganaje kila mundu kwaki, na kuneka nepani kanjika jangu. Nambu nepani ngachemi kanjika jangu, kwa ndandi Atati abhi papamu na nepani.
Numpwaghili mambu ghanihagha nahuli mpata kubha na lukwale mkati jangu. Pundema anampata ulale, nambu mulipekya mtima, kwa ndandi nepani niuweziki ndema!”
